# Meeting notes layout

```markdown
# <Meeting name>: <date in regional.date_format, or "date not stated">

Attendees: <names or roles exactly as given>
Purpose: <one line, if stated>

## Summary
<two or three lines: what the meeting was about and what changed>

## Decisions
1. <decision as agreed> (source: "<short quote from the notes>")

## Action items
| # | Action (verb first) | Owner | Due | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Send product photos to Priya | Alex | Thursday (date not converted: meeting date unknown) | "priya needs product photos from alex by thurs" |
| 2 | Update the client on the launch | **No owner** | Not set | "someone should update the client" |

## Discussion points
- <topic>: <neutral summary of views>

## Open questions
- <question>: <positions, who could decide, if named>
- Action 2 has no owner: who will update the client?

## Gaps to fill
- <missing owner, date or unclear decision>
```

Rules:

- Quote short source fragments so every decision and action can be checked.
- Keep "No owner" and "Not set" visible; do not hide gaps.
- Put sensitive topics (HR, health, pay, legal) as a single line such as "An HR matter was discussed; see HR", without details.
